text:
ira: ran into a nasty onboarding hiccup — embeddings helper in examples returns a flat vector list which breaks rerank and ANN imports.
ben: can you show the exact error?
ira: rerank threw `vectors.length !== candidates.length` and users see weird dim mismatches. helper log: `vectors.length=2048` for 2 inputs, so it flattened [2,1024] -> 2048.
sophia: ah yep, we did `res.flat()` in the cache path to simplify storage. that was a bad idea.
ira: also saw a case where embeddings model changed between runs (open-embed-small vs open-embed-large) and users copied sample code that hardcodes model names. dims were 1024 vs 1536 and rerank just crashed with an unhelpful stack.
ben: couple action items: (1) stop flattening in examples, always return nested arrays; (2) make cache writes atomic (write to temp key then rename); (3) add dimensionality validation in `sdk.rerank.score` with clear error text.
sophia: agree. suggested error: `EmbeddingDimensionMismatch: expected=1536 actual=1024 for candidate=1. Ensure embeddings and rerank use same model.`
ira: one more gotcha — when embeddings requests 429 and helper retries, partial chunks were written to cache and later concatenated. fix retry logic so cache is only populated on successful full batch, and add idempotency keys for batch requests.
ben: also update examples README and add a tiny CLI `examples/tools/check-embed-dims.js` that calls `sdk.embeddings.modelInfo()` and validates index dims before import.
sophia: I'll open a PR to examples and another to the SDK to add the explicit dim check and improved error class.
devex-bot: created issue #3772: "examples/sdk: embedding batch helper - no flattening, atomic cache writes, dim validation + retry fixes" :white_check_mark:
ira: thanks — I'll add unit tests that simulate 429 partial responses and assert cache not updated until full response.
ben: add a short changelog entry and mark it a patch fix.
